name: AI Auto Deco
description: Select blocks/structures in the editor and let an AI decorate them.

no-touch.name: Make deco No-Touch
no-touch.description: Generated objects get the No Touch flag so they never change gameplay.

max-objects.name: Max deco objects
max-objects.description: Upper limit of objects the AI may add per run.

max-tokens.name: Max tokens
max-tokens.description: Sent as max_tokens to the API. 0 = don't send.
